phase: third TAP research layer — relationship extraction/normalization/conflict/gap only
responsibility: represent what relationship the evidence establishes; NOT claim truth, governance applicability, authorization, or a user answer
honesty_notes: New, independently authored synthetic corpus; TAP-E2 query annotations are NOT reused as relationship gold.
Deterministic pattern-based extraction over sentences authored to be parseable; no model-based interpretation in this phase; no claim of general NLU.
Results are mechanism/construction validation on the synthetic corpus used in this study only.
The eval split is content-hash locked and preregistered, but was inspected during iterative engineering — a LOCKED DEVELOPMENT evaluation, not an untouched or interpreter-blind holdout.

baselines.F: full TAP-E3 (consolidation, conflict, confidence, gaps, provenance, trace)

config_selection_rule: the SIMPLEST baseline (A..F order) that satisfies ALL preregistered gates on the DEV split; the locked eval split is never used for selection.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: all gates pass on the locked eval for the selected baseline (capped by synthetic corpus + deterministic extractor)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no baseline passes all gates on dev, or 1-2 non-severe gates fail on eval
verdict_rule.FAIL: a severe gate fails or 3+ gates fail on eval
